categories.main_business_segments: China Resources Boya Bio-pharmaceutical Group primarily operates in blood products, biochemical drugs, chemical drugs, and pharmaceutical distribution. The core business is blood products including albumin, immunoglobulin, and coagulation factors. Biochemical drugs focus on orthopedic, gynecological, and immune regulation medications. The company also engages in pharmaceutical sales and is gradually divesting non-core chemical drug businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced biopharmaceutical technologies including plasma fractionation, recombinant DNA technology for coagulation factors, and patented production methods for fibrinogen. It maintains GMP-compliant manufacturing with automated process controls and continuous improvement in product yield and quality. R&D integrates internal and external resources, focusing on clinical trials, innovative biologics, and gene therapy platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are pharmaceutical distributors, hospitals, and healthcare institutions across China. The company serves clinical needs in oncology, immunology, hematology, and infectious diseases. It also targets international markets through product registrations and exports, especially for immunoglobulin products. The domestic market is the primary revenue source, with expanding presence in regions such as East China and South China.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in mainland China with extensive plasma collection stations across multiple provinces including Jiangxi, Anhui, Sichuan, and Hunan. The company has expanded through acquisition into Hong Kong and maintains export activities to countries like Pakistan and Russia. Its sales and marketing network covers all major Chinese regions, with a focus on East, South, North, and Northwest China.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Resources Boya Bio-pharmaceutical Group operates vertically integrated across the supply chain from plasma collection (upstream) through production (midstream) to sales and distribution (downstream). It owns and manages plasma collection stations, manufactures blood products, and markets directly to pharmaceutical distributors and hospitals, ensuring control over raw material supply and product delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes becoming a world-class blood products enterprise by scaling plasma collection, enhancing product innovation, and expanding international presence. R&D focuses on new immunoglobulin formulations, coagulation factors, and gene therapies with multiple products in clinical and registration phases. It invests in intelligent manufacturing facilities and digital platforms to improve efficiency and quality. Strategic acquisitions and partnerships support pipeline enrichment and market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of blood products, biochemical drugs, and chemical drugs to pharmaceutical distributors and hospitals. The company also earns income from pharmaceutical distribution services and government subsidies. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on product sales volume and pricing within regulated procurement frameworks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic blood products manufacturer competing with firms like Tiantan Bio, Taibang Bio, Shanghai RAAS, Hualan Bio, and others. The global blood products industry is oligopolistic with few major players; domestically, the company is among the top with a comprehensive product portfolio and strong plasma collection capabilities. Its acquisition of Green Cross Hong Kong enhances scale and competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.73 billion, a 34.58% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to divestitures and market conditions. Net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 67.18% to RMB 397 million, reflecting improved operational efficiency and lower impairment charges. Total assets grew 7.31% to RMB 8.4 billion, supported by acquisitions and capital investments. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with strategic expansion and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Resources Boya Bio-pharmaceutical Group emphasizes high-quality, safe, and effective blood products with superior yield and purity achieved through proprietary technologies. It leverages a vertically integrated supply chain ensuring stable plasma supply and product consistency. The company differentiates through strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines covering major blood product categories, and a robust academic marketing network enhancing clinical adoption. Its intelligent manufacturing and digital management systems further strengthen product reliability and operational excellence.
